adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the new multi-destination logic iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and, when `destination.credentialId` is present, calls `await createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` inside the loop, making those calendar API calls sequential per destination. The previous implementation only handled a single `destinationCalendar` (no loop), and the existing credentialId-less branch still uses `Promise.all`, so this change can concretely increase end-to-end booking latency for COLLECTIVE/team cases with multiple destination calendars. This is a performance/architecture concern rather than a correctness defect.
